prompt:
Use THIS frame as the exact style, architecture, palette and lighting reference, and produce a 16:9 widescreen EMPTY ENVIRONMENT PLATE from it — a background image with nothing in the middle.

REMOVE THE WOMAN COMPLETELY. There must be NO people, no figures, no humans, no silhouettes, no characters, no hologram person anywhere in the frame. The spot where she stood is now empty dark floor and empty air.

KEEP: the same vast dark vaulted Archive Hall, the same deep nave receding to a distant vanishing point in the centre, the same tall dark piers and columns down both sides, the same suspended glowing cyan light-record panels banked along the LEFT and RIGHT walls, the same polished near-black floor with long soft reflections, the same volumetric light shafts, the same cyan-and-teal-on-navy-black palette.

COMPOSITION IS THE POINT — this is a backdrop that sits behind a standing character and behind floating interface panels:
- The CENTRAL VERTICAL THIRD of the frame must be almost EMPTY and QUIET: open dark air and open dark floor, no columns crossing it, no suspended panels floating in it, no clutter, no objects. Just the hall receding into a soft distant cyan haze at the vanishing point.
- That distant centre haze should be a gentle cool glow — bright enough that a dark standing figure in front of it would read as a clean silhouette, but soft, diffuse and free of detail.
- Push ALL the density, detail and brightness OUT to the LEFT EDGE and the RIGHT EDGE of the frame: the banks of record panels, the piers, the archive shelving depth. The outer thirds carry the visual interest.
- The LOWER CENTRE is bare reflective floor: a faint cool pool of light on the floor at the centre, as if something is about to be projected there, with no ring, no dais, no object drawn.
- The upper centre rises into dark vaulting lost in shadow.

RECORD PANELS: thin floating luminous cyan rectangles, WORDLESS — no writing at all. Their faces carry only abstract non-linguistic content: soft light gradients, thin geometric grid lines, faint waveform traces, small schematic diagrams, blurred image-like blocks. No letters, words, glyphs, numerals, script or anything resembling written language.

ERA-AGNOSTIC: a timeless institutional archive. No ships, no harbour, no period townscape, no colonial buildings, no city, no maps of any recognisable place. Architecture only: piers, vaults, galleries, record banks.

STYLE LOCK: stylized real-time 3D game-engine render, clean 3D CG geometry, PBR materials, soft global illumination, volumetric haze, cinematic depth of field with the far distance softly out of focus. It MUST look like a frame from a stylized 3D video game, NOT painterly, NOT illustrated, NOT hand-drawn, NOT concept-art brushwork, NOT photoreal, NOT anime, NOT a photograph. Palette: deep desaturated navy-black architecture with cyan and teal emissive light only; no warm orange, no purple, no magenta, no green.

NO TEXT: absolutely no lettering, words, glyphs, numbers, captions, labels, titles, signage, UI text, logos, watermarks or symbols anywhere in the image. The image must be completely free of written language.
